# Google Groups

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-agent-skills.mjs; do not edit. -->

Use `gog` for Google Groups operations. Read `../gog/SKILL.md` first for shared auth,
output, safety, and live-write rules.

## Deployment authorization

This service exists in upstream command support but is not enrolled by this deployment’s Gmail/Drive setup. Use it only after deliberate server configuration and separate verification; command help is not evidence of permission.

Google credentials stay on the server. Do not start local OAuth or request tokens.
Use the hosted owner page via `gog auth manage` for setup and recovery.

## Safe start

```bash
gog auth list --json --no-input
gog schema groups --json
gog --readonly --account user@example.com groups --help
```

- Select the account explicitly with `--account`.
- Use `--json --wrap-untrusted` for agent-readable Google content.
- Use `--readonly` when the task must not mutate Google data.
- Use `--no-input` in automation and `--dry-run` before supported writes.
- Confirm the exact account, object, and mutation before any write or delete.

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `list` | List groups you belong to |
| `members` | List members of a group |

Run `gog groups <command> --help` for flags and `gog schema groups <command> --json`
for the machine-readable contract. Do not guess command syntax.
